# Happy Days Flowers

> Unique Floral Experiences. Locally grown and sourced floral experiences for
> businesses, events and gatherings across Western Pennsylvania.

Happy Days Flowers is a specialty cut flower farm in Greensburg,
Pennsylvania creating unique floral experiences throughout Western PA. Its V1
service is the Pop-Up Flower Bar: a fully stocked, delivered and styled
build-your-own-bouquet bar for corporate and private events. Inquiries are taken
through the form on the website or by email; there is no online booking, no
storefront and no published phone number.

- Canonical site: https://happydaysflowers.com/
- Location: Greensburg, Pennsylvania, United States
- Serving: Pittsburgh and surrounding communities throughout Western Pennsylvania

## A Flower Bar, Brought to You

Our Pop-Up Flower Bar arrives fully stocked with a curated selection of seasonal
flowers and everything guests need to create their own bouquet. We handle the
preparation, delivery and setup, then return for pickup when your event is over.

Perfect for client appreciation, employee events, open houses, grand openings,
showers, fundraisers and special gatherings.

You host. We bring the flowers. Your guests create something beautiful.

## How It Works

1. Choose Your Flower Bar — Select the package that best fits your expected
   number of guests.
2. We Prepare Everything — We curate and prepare the flowers, greenery, bouquet
   sleeves, signage and supplies for your event.
3. We Deliver & Style — Your flower bar arrives ready for guests to enjoy. We
   handle delivery, setup and styling.
4. Your Guests Create — Guests choose their favorite blooms, build a bouquet and
   take it home. After your event, we return to collect the flower bar.

## Flower Bar Packages

Every Happy Days Flower Bar includes a curated selection of seasonal flowers and
greenery, our 12-bucket flower bar display, bouquet sleeves, signage,
preparation, delivery, setup and pickup.

- **The Classic Flower Bar** — Up to 25 guests — $895. A complete flower bar
  experience for smaller gatherings, client events and celebrations.
- **The Social Flower Bar** — 26–50 guests — $1,495. Perfect for corporate
  events, client appreciation, open houses and larger gatherings.
- **The Full Flower Bar** — 51–75 guests — $1,995. A fully stocked flower bar
  designed for larger events and high-traffic guest experiences.
- **Custom Floral Experience** — 75+ guests — Custom quote. Planning something
  bigger? We'll create a custom flower bar experience based on your event, guest
  count and floral needs.

Packages include approximately 10 stems per participating guest. Flower
varieties and colors vary seasonally based on availability.

## Service Area

Happy Days Flowers is based in Greensburg and serves Pittsburgh and
surrounding communities throughout Western Pennsylvania. Standard delivery,
setup and pickup are included within our primary service area, approximately one
hour or 50 miles from Greensburg. Events requiring extended travel may receive a
custom travel quote.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What's included with a Happy Days Flower Bar?

Every flower bar includes a curated selection of seasonal flowers and greenery,
our 12-bucket flower bar display, bouquet sleeves, signage, preparation,
delivery, setup and pickup.

### How far do you travel? Is there a travel fee?

Happy Days Flowers is based in Greensburg and serves Pittsburgh and
surrounding communities throughout Western Pennsylvania. Standard delivery,
setup and pickup are included within our primary service area, approximately one
hour or 50 miles from Greensburg. Events requiring extended travel may receive a
custom travel quote.

### How far in advance should we book?

As early as possible is always best, particularly for popular spring, summer and
fall dates. We recommend booking at least 3–4 weeks in advance, but
shorter-notice events may be possible depending on availability.

### How many flowers does each guest get?

Packages include approximately 10 stems per participating guest. Guests choose
their own combination of flowers, greenery and seasonal accents.

### Can the flowers match our event or brand colors?

Yes. We can design the flower selection around a preferred color palette while
working with the best seasonal blooms available. Because we work with locally
grown and seasonal flowers, exact varieties cannot always be guaranteed.

### Do guests need any experience arranging flowers?

No. That's part of the fun. The flower bar is designed to make choosing and
combining flowers simple, whether someone has arranged flowers before or not.

### Can the flower bar be outdoors? What if it rains?

Yes, with appropriate weather conditions and a protected location. Flowers
should be kept out of direct sun and extreme heat, and outdoor events should
have a covered or indoor backup location in case of rain or severe weather.

### What happens after the event?

We return after your event to collect the flower bar display and reusable setup
pieces. Your guests take their bouquets home with them.

## Why Happy Days?

- **Locally Grown + Thoughtfully Sourced** — Whenever the season allows, our
  flower bars feature blooms grown right here at Happy Days Flowers in
  Greensburg, Pennsylvania. We thoughtfully source additional flowers and
  greenery to create a full, beautiful selection year-round.
- **Designed Around the Season** — No two flower bars need to look exactly alike.
  Colors, textures and varieties change with the season, creating an experience
  that feels fresh and unique to your event.
- **Beautifully Simple** — We take care of the flowers, preparation, display,
  delivery, setup and pickup. Your guests simply choose the blooms they love and
  create a bouquet to take home.
- **More Than a Favor** — Our flower bars give your guests something beautiful to
  bring home, something memorable to talk about, and something that makes them
  feel appreciated and genuinely happy!
